messages:
alice: Quick heads-up — v1.12.0 release planned for tomorrow. Cutoff for merges is 16:00 UTC. Please land changelogs, version-bump PRs, and tag any rollback-safe changes. :bell:

sam: Got it — my batching perf PR is green, will merge before cutoff. PR #487.

carol: API schema change (breaking?) is in PR #492 — needs QA sign-off. tagging @dylan for testing.

dylan: QA picked it up, ran integration tests, found a null-pointer on auth edge-case. Repro steps in the PR. Will have a patch by EOD.

jen: heads-up, e2e is flaky on staging. I kicked a rerun of the pipeline. If it keeps failing we should consider slipping.

ci-bot: ci/build — e2e-tests failed on staging (flaky-tests). See: https://ci.internal/runs/8842 — failing step: e2e:session-timeout

jen: the failure is from a timeout in chrome-runner; I can try bumping retries but it may take ~30m. If not fixed by 15:30 UTC, propose we move cutover to 18:30 UTC.

alice: OK — proposal recorded. We need a short announcement draft ready if we slip. Drafting below, please thumbs-up if OK to post to #announcements when we confirm.

alice: DRAFT for #announcements:
"""
Heads-up: The v1.12.0 release is targeted for tomorrow. We hit an intermittent e2e test failure in staging; engineering is debugging. If we cannot resolve before 16:00 UTC, the release will be delayed to 18:30 UTC to ensure stability. We will update this channel once we have a firm ETA.
"""

sam: +1 on the draft. Keep the ETA callout.

carol: +1. Also add that any hotfixes after cutoff need explicit mention in the PR body so release engineer can prioritize.

alice: noted — I'll add a one-liner about hotfix procedure.

deploy-bot: release-manager — holding tag creation until final approval. Current release branch: release/v1.12.0, head: commit ab3f9c2.

dylan: patched the null-pointer in #495, tests passing locally. Pushed fix.

ci-bot: ci/build — rerun succeeded, all checks green (integration + unit).

jen: e2e rerun passed too. Flake looks mitigated after increasing retry logic. Will keep an eye on staging for 1h.

alice: Great. Because tests are green and fixes are in, we will keep the 16:00 UTC cutoff. I'll post the release notice to #announcements at 15:50 UTC with ETA 17:00 UTC for rollout window and note the canary strategy. Anyone planning last-minute changes, speak now.

sam: merging my PR now.

carol: removing the [WIP] tag from #492.

alice: Posted to #announcements: 'v1.12.0 scheduled — cutoff 16:00 UTC. Rollout window ~17:00-18:00 UTC. If anything slips we'll update here.' :loud_sound:

deploy-bot: release-manager — tag v1.12.0 created and signed off by alice at 1719003600.

alice: final note: please update CHANGELOG entry format (one-line summary + 1-2 bullet points) if you haven't. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.

sam: thanks team.

jen: monitoring staging post-merge. will flag immediately if regressions.
